NAME: CPU core verification plan
details: Source: GARUDA-CORE-SPEC-001, section 2 (requirements), section 10 (assertions) and section 11 (verification plan), written with the specification. Moved into vPlanner form on 2026-10-04; section 4 holds what the 2026-10-04 flow run added.

NAME: Requirements
details: From section 2 of the specification; planned tests from section 11.

NAME: R-1 RV32I base plus M extension. No A F D C.
details: RV32I base plus M extension. No A, F, D, C.
implementation_note: Source: System Section 11 plans no test against this requirement. Evidence that exists: 63 riscv-tests (rv32ui, rv32um, rv32mi), 63 of 63 pass; 57 of the 63 are also compared with Spike instruction for instruction; p-div, p-divu, p-rem, p-remu, p-sbreak and p-mcsr are judged by their own pass/fail only, because GARUDA and Spike differ there by design (software divide, CLIC mtvec, mimpid).

NAME: R-2 M-mode only. No U or S mode no PMP.
details: M-mode only. No U or S mode, no PMP.
implementation_note: Source: System Section 11 plans no test against this requirement. Evidence that exists: the rv32mi tests in the lockstep regression.

NAME: R-3 Five-stage in-order pipeline single issue.
implementation_note: Source: System Section 11 plans no test against this requirement. Evidence that exists: unit benches for each stage (20 pass) and the lockstep regression.

NAME: R-4 All synchronous exceptions precise.
implementation_note: Source: Priv spec Section 11 plans no test against this requirement. Evidence that exists: rv32mi tests, sw/tests/t_buserr.S, sw/chip/t_chip_integ.c precise bus faults. T-9 and T-10 were violations of this requirement, found on 2026-10-04.

NAME: R-5 CLIC-mode interrupts mtvec.MODE = 3.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0009 Section 11 plans no test against this requirement. Evidence that exists: sw/tests/t_clic.S and t_irq.S, sw/chip/t_chip_irq.c and t_chip_integ.c.

NAME: R-6 The machine timer shall arrive as a single mtip_i wire.
details: The machine timer shall arrive as a single mtip_i wire.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0010

NAME: t_core_mtip
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: sw/tests/t_mtip.S on tb/soc/tb_boot.v (sim/sanity/t_mtip.log: TOHOST=1 PASSED, 281 cycles clock-gated): mtip alone wakes the core. Trap through mip.MTIP at chip level: sw/chip/t_chip_irq.c and t_chip_integ.c, RESULT: PASSED.

NAME: planned test
implementation_note: Status in the specification: review gate. Bench: Review, repeated 2026-10-04: rtl/core/garuda_core_top.v has the single input mtip_i (line 72) and no mtime or mtimecmp port.

NAME: R-7 A debug-controlled reset shall stop the core without disturbing ...
details: A debug-controlled reset shall stop the core without disturbing the bus.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0012

NAME: t_core_hartreset
details: Oracle: core resets; bus and peripherals unaffected
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: PARTLY IMPLEMENTED - the request path is checked in tb/clk_div/tb_crg.sv (t_hartreset) and tb/debug/tb_debug.sv; no test resets a running core with hartreset and checks that the bus and peripherals are undisturbed (tb_boot ties hartreset_n_i high).

NAME: R-8 WFI shall stop the core s clock and wake on a pending enabled ...
details: WFI shall stop the core's clock and wake on a pending enabled interrupt.
implementation_note: Source: Power

NAME: t_core_wfi_gate
details: Oracle: clock stops during WFI, restarts on wake
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: sw/tests/t_wfi.S on tb/soc/tb_boot.v (sim/sanity/t_wfi.log: TOHOST=1 PASSED, 377 cycles clock-gated) and t_mtip.S; at chip level sw/chip/t_chip_irq.c (WFI and the clock gate), RESULT: PASSED.

NAME: t_core_wfi_mie
details: Oracle: wake with MIE set (traps) and clear (resumes) Coverage goal: both
implementation_note: Status in the specification: extend. Bench: MIE clear: sw/tests/t_mtip.S (wake resumes after the WFI with no trap). MIE set: sw/tests/t_wfi.S and sw/tests/t_hold_flush_matrix.S bits 12 to 18. All TOHOST=1 PASSED in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: t_core_wfi_latency
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: NOT IMPLEMENTED - no bench measures the wake latency, and a_wake_latency is not implemented.

NAME: R-9 The DSU shall be an in-pipeline EX extension not a bus peripheral.
details: The DSU shall be an in-pipeline EX extension, not a bus peripheral.
implementation_note: Source: System Section 11 plans no test against this requirement. Evidence that exists: sw/tests/t_dsu.S and t_dsu_b2b.S; see the DSU plan.

NAME: R-10 Target 250 MHz with a documented fallback if closure fails.
details: Target 250 MHz, with a documented fallback if closure fails.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0001 A timing requirement, closed in synthesis and timing analysis, outside stages 1 to 6.

NAME: Planned tests not tied to one requirement
t_core_hold_flush_matrix
details: Oracle: all 20 combinations of [N-7.23] Coverage goal: 20/20
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new — the priority test. Bench: sw/tests/t_hold_flush_matrix.S (new 2026-10-04): 19 cells, one result bit each, checked on architectural state; sim/sanity/t_hold_flush_matrix.log TOHOST=1 PASSED, and it passes under the interrupt-period and wait-state sweep (+IRQ_EVERY, +DWAIT, +DRAND) that found T-11 and P-8. Which cells are reached: make pipe_matrix (cover points c_h*_vs_* in rtl/core/pipe_ctrl_sva.sv). The plan says 20 combinations; the program has 19 cells.

NAME: t_core_h2_defer
details: Oracle: flush deferred by an outstanding transfer, at each wait-state count Coverage goal: 1–4 waits
implementation_note: Status in the specification: extend (T-7 guard). Bench: a_h2_defers_flush and a_h2_defers_flush_loaduse in rtl/core/pipe_ctrl_sva.sv, bound in every core simulation, 0 failures; exercised by make regress_rand (the 63 ISA tests under random bus waits, 57 of them also compared with Spike; 63 pass in the last run, 2026-10-04 07:52) and by t_hold_flush_matrix under +DWAIT.

NAME: t_core_gate_safety
details: Oracle: never gated with a bus transfer or flush pending
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: a_no_gate_with_bus, a_no_gate_mid_work and a_no_gate_with_flush in rtl/core/pipe_ctrl_sva.sv, bound in every core simulation: 0 failures across t_wfi, t_mtip, t_hold_flush_matrix and the chip tests (SVA-1 corrected a_no_gate_with_flush on 2026-10-04).

NAME: t_core_div_trap
details: Oracle: all four M-extension divide instructions trap and return correctly Coverage goal: 4 instructions × edge operands
implementation_note: Status in the specification: extend. Bench: riscv-tests rv32um div, divu, rem, remu (sim/regress/p-div, p-divu, p-rem, p-remu .run.log): each takes the illegal-instruction trap, is emulated in software and passes its own check (TOHOST=1 PASSED) in the 2026-10-04 regression. These four are not compared with Spike: Spike divides in one instruction, GARUDA in about 100, so the streams cannot match.

NAME: t_core_debug_csr
details: Oracle: dcsr/dpc/dscratch raise illegal instruction Coverage goal: 4 CSRs
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: PARTLY IMPLEMENTED - tb/core/tb_csr_file.v line 34 checks dcsr (0x7B0) raises illegal instruction (sim/unit_csr_file/run.log: ALL CHECKS PASSED); dpc and the two dscratch registers are not checked, so 1 of the 4 CSRs.

NAME: a_mtip_to_mip
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Behaviour checked by sw/tests/t_mtip.S.

NAME: a_hartreset_resets
details: hartreset produces a full core reset (R-7)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED - named in the specification only; see t_core_hartreset.

NAME: a_gate_enable_is_quiescent
details: THE Rev 3.0 property: the clock gate uses pipe_ctrl's quiescent, nothing else
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED under this name. The nearest property is a_no_gate_mid_work, rtl/core/pipe_ctrl_sva.sv:116.

NAME: a_no_gate_with_bus
details: the core is never gated with a bus transfer outstanding
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Implemented: rtl/core/pipe_ctrl_sva.sv:111, bound in every core simulation.

NAME: a_no_gate_with_flush
details: the core is never gated while any flush is pending
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Implemented: rtl/core/pipe_ctrl_sva.sv:137, bound in every core simulation (corrected 2026-10-04, SVA-1).

NAME: a_wfi_wake_mie_clear
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Behaviour checked by sw/tests/t_mtip.S (MIE = 0, wake without a trap).

NAME: a_wake_latency
details: wake latency is bounded at 2 cycles (N-7.30)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED - named in the specification only.

NAME: a_flush_beats_hold
details: flush beats hold, for every combination except H2 (N-7.21, N-7.23)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Implemented as three properties: a_flush_beats_hold_if_id, _id_ex and _ex_mem, rtl/core/pipe_ctrl_sva.sv:70, 73, 76.

NAME: a_h2_defers_flush
details: the H2 exception: flush deferred until hready (N-7.24)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Implemented: rtl/core/pipe_ctrl_sva.sv:90 (and a_h2_defers_flush_loaduse, line 93).

NAME: a_mem_completes
details: a committed load/store always writes back (N-7.25)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. A lost load or store would show as a mismatch against Spike in the lockstep regression.

NAME: a_trap_beats_branch
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Implemented: rtl/core/pipe_ctrl_sva.sv:102.

NAME: a_debug_csr_illegal
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/core/tb_csr_file.v line 34 (dcsr only).

NAME: a_mnxti_zero
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/core/tb_csr_file.v line 31 (mnxti reads 0 and is legal).

NAME: Coverage
details: Merged code coverage from the vManager session of 2026-10-04 (sim/cov_merged). Not closed; no bar is claimed.

NAME: Added in the 2026-10-04 run
details: Checks added and defects found when the flow was run in order on 2026-10-04 (Docs/BUGS.md section 1h). Eleven RTL defects in the core, all found by tests written that day.

NAME: C-13 reserved register-register encodings executed
details: funct7 = 0100000 was accepted for every funct3; it exists only for SUB and SRA, so 0x402091b3 ran as SLL where Spike raises illegal instruction.
implementation_note: FIXED in rtl/core/decode_control.v. Covered by the reserved_funct7 sequence in tb/core/tb_decode_control.sv; PASS.

NAME: C-14 illegal instruction left reg_write set
details: A reserved shift-immediate reached EX flagged illegal with a register write still enabled; the decoder's own contract (no side effects) was not met.
implementation_note: FIXED in rtl/core/decode_control.v; the decoder forces an inert bundle when illegal. tb_decode_control; PASS.

NAME: C-15 FENCE.I raced an older store
details: FENCE.I redirects from ID, so the refetch went out while the store before it was still in EX or on the D-port; with one wait state the core executed the word the store was replacing.
implementation_note: FIXED in rtl/core/garuda_core_top.v. t_hold_flush_matrix bit 6; PASS.

NAME: T-9 trap during a pending load or store lost its redirect
details: A trap taken while a load or store was still on the D-port entered the trap at once while pipe_ctrl withheld the redirect; for an interrupt the request was gone when the transfer finished.
implementation_note: FIXED in rtl/core/trap_ctrl.v (mem_stall_i). t_hold_flush_matrix bits 1, 2, 4, 5 and sw/chip/t_chip_integ.c; PASS.

NAME: T-10 bus error did not squash the next instruction
details: On a load or store bus error the younger instruction in EX moved into MEM, did its own bus access and wrote its register before the handler ran.
implementation_note: FIXED in rtl/core/trap_ctrl.v. sw/chip/t_chip_integ.c precise bus faults and sw/tests/t_buserr.S; PASS.

NAME: T-11 interrupt on a WFI put the core to sleep in the handler
details: When an interrupt was taken in the cycle a WFI sat in EX, the WFI was squashed but still armed the sleep latch, so the core slept on the first instruction of the handler.
implementation_note: FIXED in rtl/core/trap_ctrl.v. Found and covered by the t_hold_flush_matrix timing sweep (+IRQ_EVERY, +DWAIT); PASS.

NAME: P-4 idle loop lost a load on wake
details: During a WFI sleep a load parked behind the WFI was destroyed by its own load-use flush: while (!flag) wfi; woke up and skipped the load.
implementation_note: FIXED in rtl/core/pipe_ctrl.v. t_hold_flush_matrix bit 12; PASS.

NAME: P-5 JALR behind a WFI wrote no link register
details: A JALR or mispredicted branch parked in EX behind a WFI redirected fetch, was flushed by its own redirect and never retired.
implementation_note: FIXED in rtl/core/pipe_ctrl.v. t_hold_flush_matrix bit 13; PASS.

NAME: P-6 CSR instruction wrote on every held cycle
details: A CSR instruction wrote its CSR on every cycle it sat in EX and in the cycle it was squashed, so csrrw returned the value it had just written.
implementation_note: FIXED in rtl/core/csr_file.v and garuda_core_top.v (commit_i). t_hold_flush_matrix bits 7, 14; PASS.

NAME: P-7 DSU operation ran once per held cycle
details: A MAC behind a store or behind a WFI accumulated its product every cycle it waited.
implementation_note: FIXED in rtl/core/garuda_core_top.v. t_hold_flush_matrix bits 8, 15; PASS.

NAME: P-8 clock gate closed with an instruction in MEM or WB
details: A load or store stretched by wait states just before a WFI was left unretired for the whole sleep.
implementation_note: FIXED in rtl/core/garuda_core_top.v. Found by the t_hold_flush_matrix timing sweep (+IRQ_EVERY=61 +DWAIT=2 +DRAND=1); PASS.

NAME: SVA-1 a_no_gate_with_flush was wrong
details: The assertion listed ex_mem_flush, which pipe_ctrl drives from the WFI hold itself, so it failed on every WFI sleep by construction.
implementation_note: FIXED (assertion). It now checks applied redirects and the IF/ID, ID/EX and MEM/WB flushes; 0 failures.

NAME: AUD-8 the hold versus flush matrix test did not exist
details: Section 11 of the specification names t_core_hold_flush_matrix as its priority test; no such test existed.
implementation_note: CLOSED in simulation by sw/tests/t_hold_flush_matrix.S. Formal on pipe_ctrl is not run: no IFV licence (FV-1).

NAME: ELEM-1..6 and TB-27
details: Six element testbenches had never passed or never compiled; the common cause (TB-27) was a variable initialised inside a loop in a static block, which made the random soaks constant.
implementation_note: FIXED (testbenches); RTL correct in all six. 20 unit and element benches now pass with 0 assertion failures.

NAME: Tests added
details: sw/tests/t_hold_flush_matrix.S (19 hold-versus-flush cells, passes under the interrupt-period and wait-state sweep (+IRQ_EVERY, +DWAIT, +DRAND) that found T-11 and P-8), reserved_funct7 sequence in tb_decode_control.
